title: Validated generic path (LLM planner)

trigger.on_match: never trigger-matched; this contract is the no-match fallback — its policy blocks are applied by plan_validator to planner-emitted task graphs

artifact_roots.publish_rule: none (planner-declared write_scope must already resolve inside a declared root; a bare relative path is the v9 shape and is rejected as ARTIFACT_ROOT_UNRESOLVED, corpus F-051)

note: pm.generic.v1 is itself a contract (workflow-contract-unification-plan.md section 4): stages are planner-generated, so it is never instantiated; plan_validator applies the same compile-check core (task_type admission, obligation legality by node_kind, normalize-then-check root containment, route resolvability) to planner output. Node-kind proof legality is the single exported table in workflow_contract.NODE_KIND_LEGAL_PROOF_KINDS, not a per-contract copy.
